"];
const storyCopy=[['01　/　内蒙古','风走过草原','站到一望无际的草地上，你会想先问当地朋友什么？'],['02　/　西藏','等一束金色的光','雪山先醒了。有人等的是日照金山，有人正准备一天的早饭。'],['03　/　岭南','听，鼓点近了','岸上、船头、回家的餐桌，每个人都有自己的端午。']];
function drawIntro(){let dlg=document.getElementById('welcome');if(!dlg){dlg=document.createElement('dialog');dlg.id='welcome';document.body.append(dlg);dlg.addEventListener('cancel',e=>{if(initialIntro)e.preventDefault()});dlg.showModal()}if(slide<3){let a=storyCopy[slide];dlg.innerHTML='<section class="poster" style="background-image:linear-gradient(0deg,#101e17ed,transparent 65%),url('+covers[slide]+')"><div class="wtop"><b>你那边呢？</b><button onclick="slide=3;drawIntro()">跳至兴趣选择　›</button></div><div class="wbase"><span class="edition">'+a[0]+'</span><h1>'+a[1]+'</h1><p>'+a[2]+'</p><div class="wrow"><button aria-label="上一张" '+(slide===0?'disabled':'')+' onclick="slide--;drawIntro()">←</button><span>'+[0,1,2].map(n=>n===slide?'━':'·').join('　')+'</span><button onclick="slide++;drawIntro()">'+(slide===2?'选择兴趣':'下一张')+'　→</button></div></div></section>'}else{dlg.innerHTML='<div class="pref"><span class="series">FIELD GUIDE　/　YOUR INTERESTS</span><h1>你想聊点什么？</h1><p>选择一个或多个兴趣，我们会把相关讨论放在一起。</p><div class="ig">'+interestList.map((t,i)=>'<button aria-pressed="'+chosen.includes(t)+'" onclick="togglePref('+i+')">'+(chosen.includes(t)?'✓ ':'＋ ')+t+'</button>').join('')+'</div><button class="solid full" '+(!chosen.length?'disabled':'')+' onclick="finishPref()">看看我的兴趣内容　·　'+chosen.length+'</button><button class="back" onclick="slide=2;drawIntro()">‹　回看海报</button></div>'}}
function togglePref(i){let t=interestList[i];chosen=chosen.includes(t)?chosen.filter(x=>x!==t):[...chosen,t];drawIntro()}function finishPref(){if(!chosen.length)return;preferences=[...chosen];try{localStorage.setItem(prefsKey,JSON.stringify(preferences))}catch{}initialIntro=false;let d=$('welcome');d.close();d.remove();pickTag='';route('picks',0)}function changePrefs(s=3){chosen=[...preferences];slide=s;drawIntro()}function viewTag(i){pickTag=i<0?'':preferences[i];paint();$('app').scrollTop=0}
function readPick(id){fromPicks=true;read(id)}
const prior=paint;paint=function(){prior();if(page==='picks'){let active=pickTag?[pickTag]:preferences;let list=posts().filter(x=>tagged(x).some(k=>active.includes(k))).sort((a,b)=>Number(active.includes(extraCategory[b.id]))-Number(active.includes(extraCategory[a.id])));$('app').innerHTML=inside('<div class="series">YOUR EDITION　/　个人兴趣选刊</div><div class="spread"><h1>为你推荐</h1>'+B('调整兴趣','changePrefs()')+'</div><p class="small gap">按你选择的兴趣，看看不同地方的青年在聊什么。</p><div class="tabs">'+B('已选全部','viewTag(-1)','chip '+(!pickTag?'sel':''))+preferences.map((t,i)=>B(t,'viewTag('+i+')','chip '+(pickTag===t?'sel':''))).join('')+'</div>'+list.map(x=>'<article class="post">'+author(x.p)+'<button class="topic" onclick="readPick('+x.id+')"><h3>'+E(x.t)+'</h3><p class="excerpt">'+E(x.v)+'</p><span class="cat"># '+tagged(x).filter(k=>active.includes(k)).join('　# ')+'</span></button></article>').join('')+B('浏览全部首页话题','home(0)','soft full'))}if(page==='detail'&&fromPicks){let b=$('app').querySelector('.back');b.textContent='‹　兴趣推荐';b.onclick=()=>{fromPicks=false;route('picks',0)}}if(page==='home'){fromPicks=false;let box=$('app').querySelector('.pad');box.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<div class="prefShortcut">'+B('为你推荐　›',"route('picks',0)",'soft')+'<small>'+E(preferences.join(' · '))+'</small></div>')}if(page==='mine')$('app').querySelector('.panel').insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',B('我的兴趣　·　'+E(preferences.join(' / ')),'changePrefs()','subarea')+B('重看地域海报','changePrefs(0)','subarea'));if(page==='place')$('app').querySelector('.gap').textContent='外地朋友最想问什么？'};paint();if(initialIntro)drawIntro();else route('picks',0);
const bottleSeeds=lines.map((t,i)=>({id:'sea'+i,s:'L'+i,place:places[i][0],body:t+'\n\n'+places[i][1+(i%3)*2]+'如果有机会，也想听听你那边的故事。'}));
S.sea??={sent:[],seen:{},saved:{},draft:{}};let floating=null,letter=null,seaNote='',uncorking=false,tideTimer,glassSerial=0,fromChest=false;
function glass(w=''){let id='glass'+(++glassSerial);return '<svg class="glass '+w+'" viewBox="0 0 100 146" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="'+id+'" x1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#71fbe9"/><stop offset=".30" stop-color="#68c9ff"/><stop offset=".59" stop-color="#9c8ef3"/><stop offset=".82" stop-color="#e497db"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffbd91"/></linearGradient></defs><g transform="rotate(13 50 75)"><g class="stopper"><path d="M38 9q10-4 23 0l-2 15H41z" fill="#af7753" stroke="#633e36" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m42 10 14 1m-10 5 4 1" stroke="#e0b28b" stroke-width="2"/></g><path d="M38 23h23v8l-3 2v17c0 8 23 12 23 30v41q0 13-13 14H32q-13-1-13-14V80c0-18 23-22 23-30V33l-4-2Z" fill="url(#'+id+')" stroke="#565780" stroke-width="2.3"/><path d="M24 94q15-7 27 0t25-2v27q0 11-10 12H35q-11-1-11-10z" fill="#8881d2" opacity=".5"/><g transform="rotate(-24 50 97)" class="roll"><path d="M40 75h18v43H40z" fill="#b89463" stroke="#805e3f"/><ellipse cx="49" cy="75" rx="9" ry="3" fill="#d7bd8d"/><path d="M40 94h18v5H40z" fill="#ab5364"/></g><path d="M46 37v14c0 9-18 14-20 28v21m0 6v5" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".82"/><path d="M38 27h23" stroke="#d1f7ff" stroke-width="4"/></g></svg>'}
const stockLetters=[['b','黔东南','我家过苗年时，我总爱搬一张矮凳坐在厨房门边。不是等第一口饭，是想看看今年谁先推开门。我给你留一个位置，你那边的节日从哪一刻开始？'],['d','呼和浩特','朋友以为奶茶总是甜的。我给他倒了家里常喝的那一种，又把炒米放在桌上让他自己添。比解释“正不正宗”有意思多了。你家有什么得尝一口才说得清的味道？'],['e','泉州','我小时候记住中秋，是因为骰子碰到碗的声音。这两天想起的反倒是大家弯腰找骰子的样子。你最熟悉的节日，听起来是什么声音？'],['c','昆明','我把火把节那天的照片翻了一遍，最喜欢的却是散场后朋友并肩走路的背影。想把那段路寄给你。你有没有一张，别人看不懂你却舍不得删的照片？'],['a','南京','我以前和朋友约见面，习惯只说“老地方”。直到新同学问我是哪一棵梧桐树，我才发觉，有人记得一条街，有人记得那条街上的一个人。你的老地方叫什么？']].map(([s,place,body],i)=>({id:'story'+i,s,place,body}));
const allLetters=()=>[...S.sea.sent,...stockLetters,...bottleSeeds],known=()=>(S.sea.seen[S.me]||[]),personalLetters=()=>S.sea.sent.filter(l=>l.to===S.me&&l.s!==S.me),allIncoming=()=>[...personalLetters(),...stockLetters,...bottleSeeds].filter(l=>l.s!==S.me);
function rand(a){let r=new Uint32Array(1);crypto.getRandomValues(r);return a[Math.floor(r[0]/4294967296*a.length)]}
function selectFloating(){let incoming=allIncoming().filter(l=>!known().includes(l.id)),priority=incoming.filter(l=>l.to===S.me);floating=(priority.length||incoming.length)?rand(priority.length?priority:incoming):null}
function seaHome(){clearTimeout(tideTimer);uncorking=false;letter=null;fromChest=false;seaNote='';selectFloating();route('sea',4)}
function seaOpen(){if(uncorking||!floating)return;uncorking=true;document.querySelector('.afloat')?.classList.add('popped');let item=floating;tideTimer=setTimeout(()=>{uncorking=false;if(page!=='sea'||item!==floating)return;letter=item;let seen=S.sea.seen[S.me]??=[];if(!seen.includes(item.id))seen.push(item.id);sv();route('seaLetter',4)},matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?30:850)}
function composeSea(){seaNote='';route('seaWrite',4)}
function toss(){let txt=$('seaText').value.trim();if(!txt){$('seaErr').textContent='先写一点你想寄出去的地方故事。';$('seaText').focus();return}if(txt.length>600)return;let target=rand(Object.keys(P).filter(k=>k!==S.me&&myTags(k).area!==myTags(S.me).area));let item={id:'user'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),s:S.me,to:target,place:myTags(S.me).area||'未署地区',dest:myTags(target).area||'远方',body:txt};S.sea.sent.unshift(item);S.sea.draft[S.me]='';sv();seaNote=item.dest;selectFloating();route('seaSent',4)}
function keepDraft(){S.sea.draft[S.me]=$('seaText').value;sv()}function book(){clearTimeout(tideTimer);uncorking=false;route('seaBook',4)}
function replayLetter(id){let l=allLetters().find(x=>x.id===id);if(!l||!(known().includes(id)||l.s===S.me))return;fromChest=true;letter=l;route('seaLetter',4)}
function getMore(){seaNote='';selectFloating();route('sea',4)}
function storeSea(){if(!letter)return;let a=S.sea.saved[S.me]??=[];if(a.includes(letter.id))S.sea.saved[S.me]=a.filter(x=>x!==letter.id);else a.push(letter.id);sv();paint()}
const labelPlace=k=>myTags(k).area||'远方',oceanButton=(s,fn,cl='oBtn')=>B(s,fn,cl);
function authorSea(){if(letter&&letter.s!==S.me)profile(letter.s)}
function seaRender(){let h='',me=S.me;const subnav='<div class="seaTools">'+oceanButton('‹　回到海面','seaHome()','seaBack')+oceanButton('信匣','book()','seaBack')+'</div>';
if(page==='sea'){let total=allIncoming().filter(l=>!known().includes(l.id)).length;h='<div class="seaHero"><div class="seaTop"><span class="seaMono">OCEAN POST　/　海上邮局</span>'+oceanButton('我的信匣','book()','seaBack')+'</div><h1>远方来潮</h1><p>让一句家乡话，遇见另一片岸。</p></div><div class="seaMiddle">'+(floating?'<button class="afloat" aria-label="打开漂来的瓶子" onclick="seaOpen()">'+glass()+'<span class="waveRing"></span></button><span class="pickHint">轻触瓶身 · 拔塞读信</span>':'<div class="pickHint">这次潮汐的来信都读过了，去信匣重读吧。</div>')+'</div><div class="oceanDock"><span class="seaMono">本次潮汐　/　'+total+' 封未读来信</span>'+oceanButton('＋　写信，投一只瓶子','composeSea()')+oceanButton('换一只漂来的瓶子','getMore()','clearSea')+'</div>'}
if(page==='seaWrite'){h=subnav+'<div class="seaHero compact"><div class="seaMono">OUTGOING　/　离岸邮笺</div><h1>寄给未知的岸</h1></div><section class="writeCard"><label for="seaText">来自 '+E(labelPlace(me))+' 的 '+E(P[me][0])+'</label><p>介绍一件只有听你讲，远方朋友才会懂的小事。</p><textarea maxlength="600" id="seaText" oninput="keepDraft()" placeholder="远方的朋友，你好。我们家……">'+E(S.sea.draft[me]||'')+'</textarea><span id="seaErr" role="status"></span>'+oceanButton('封好纸条，投向大海　↗','toss()')+'<small>投递后随机漂向异地体验身份。草稿自动留在本机。</small></section>'}
if(page==='seaSent'){h='<div class="sentDay">'+glass('thrown')+'<span class="seaMono">MESSAGE AFLOAT</span><h1>瓶子出发了</h1><p>这一次，洋流将它送往<br><b>'+E(seaNote)+'</b> 的一位朋友。</p>'+oceanButton('看看海面上的来信','seaHome()')+oceanButton('查看寄出记录','book()','clearSea')+'</div>'}
if(page==='seaLetter'&&letter){let own=letter.s===me;h=subnav+'<section class="oldLetter"><div class="paperInk"><div class="paperHead"><span>海上来信</span><span>OCEAN MAIL</span></div><button class="penFriend" onclick="authorSea()" '+(own?'disabled':'')+'>'+av(letter.s)+'<span><b>'+E(P[letter.s][0])+'</b><small>'+E(letter.place)+'　/　'+(own?'我的署名':'点头像认识写信人　↗')+'</small></span></button><h2>远方的朋友，你好：</h2><p class="inkBody">'+E(letter.body)+'</p><div class="signed">来自 '+E(letter.place)+' 的朋友<br>'+E(P[letter.s][0])+'</div></div></section><div class="letterBtns">'+(!own?oceanButton((S.sea.saved[me]||[]).includes(letter.id)?'✓ 已收藏 · 取消':'收藏这封信','storeSea()'):'')+oceanButton(fromChest?'回到信匣':'回到海面',fromChest?'book()':'seaHome()','clearSea')+'</div>'}
if(page==='seaBook'){let seen=known().slice().reverse().map(id=>allLetters().find(l=>l.id===id)).filter(Boolean),sent=S.sea.sent.filter(l=>l.s===me);let rows=(a,out)=>a.map(l=>'<button class="mailRow" onclick="replayLetter(\''+l.id+'\')"><b>'+E(out?'寄往 '+l.dest:P[l.s][0]+' · '+l.place)+'</b><small>'+((S.sea.saved[me]||[]).includes(l.id)?'★ ':'')+E(l.body.slice(0,30))+'</small></button>').join('');h=subnav+'<section class="bookCard"><div class="seaMono">PERSONAL POSTBOX</div><h1>我的信匣</h1><h3>收到的　'+seen.length+'</h3>'+(rows(seen,false)||'<p>海面上点开瓶子，来信就会留在这里。</p>')+'<h3>寄出的　'+sent.length+'</h3>'+(rows(sent,true)||'<p>还没有寄出的信。</p>')+'</section>'}
return '<div class="seaStage st-'+page+'">'+h+'</div>'}
const beforeSea=paint;paint=function(){beforeSea();let active=page.startsWith('sea');document.querySelector('main').classList.toggle('seaActive',active);let nv=$('nav'),nodes=nv.querySelectorAll('button');nodes[1].insertAdjacentHTML('afterend','<button class="bottleNav '+(active?'selected':'')+'" onclick="seaHome()" aria-label="漂流瓶，进入海上邮局">'+glass()+'<span>漂流瓶</span></button>');if(active){$('app').innerHTML=seaRender();document.querySelector('header>.series').textContent='海上邮局'}else if(document.querySelector('header>.series'))document.querySelector('header>.series').textContent='地方生活志';
if(page==='identity'){let allowed=new Set([...known().map(id=>allLetters().find(l=>l.id===id)?.s),...S.sea.sent.filter(l=>l.s===S.me).map(l=>l.to)]);allowed.forEach(k=>{if(k&&k.startsWith('L'))$('app').querySelector('.pad').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',B(av(k)+'<strong>'+E(P[k][0])+'</strong>'+tags(k)+'<small class="end">海上往来 · 切换</small>',"actAs('"+k+"')",'person'))})}
};paint();
</script>

</style><script>(function(){try{document.getElementById('welcome')?.close();document.getElementById('welcome')?.remove()}catch{}preferences=['节日民俗','饮食习惯','日常生活'];
function fc(z){return '<article class="feedCard">'+author(z.p)+'<button class="question" onclick="read('+JSON.stringify(z.id)+')"><h3>'+E(z.t)+'</h3><p class="excerpt">'+E(z.v)+'</p></button><div class="feedMeta"><span># '+cats[z.c]+'</span><span>'+cm(z).length+' 条回应　›</span></div></article>'}
function fresh(){let a=$('app');if(!a)return;
if(page==='home'){let l=posts().filter(x=>!filter||x.c===filter).slice(0,homeLimit);a.innerHTML='<main class="fresh"><header class="intro"><div class="eyebrow">你那边呢？ · 青年生活交流</div><h1>从一件小事，认识一座城。</h1><p>聊节日怎么过、饭桌怎么吃、每天怎么生活。每条分享都是个人经历，不替一个地方下结论。</p><button class="primaryAction" onclick="route(\'new\',0)">＋ 分享你那边的生活</button></header><div class="sectionHead"><div><div class="eyebrow">COMMUNITY</div><h2>正在发生的讨论</h2></div><small>经历 · 提问 · 回应</small></div><div class="topicFilters">'+cats.map((c,i)=>B(c,'filt('+i+')','chip '+(filter===i?'sel':''))).join('')+'</div>'+l.map(fc).join('')+(posts().filter(x=>!filter||x.c===filter).length>homeLimit?B('继续看讨论','moreHome()','soft full'):'')+'<p class="purposeNote">首页是正在交流的帖子。按地区系统浏览资料，请去“发现”。</p></main>';return}
if(page==='discover'){a.innerHTML='<main class="fresh"><header class="discoverHero"><div class="eyebrow">DISCOVER · 地方生活资料馆</div><h1>按地区认识生活</h1><p>先看一地的节日、饮食和日常例子，再带着具体问题回到首页交流。</p></header><div class="sectionHead"><div><div class="eyebrow">REGIONS</div><h2>选择一个文化区域</h2></div><small>7 个区域</small></div><div class="regionGrid">'+atlas.map((r,i)=>'<button class="regionTile" onclick="region='+i+';route(\'region\',2)"><span class="glyph">'+r[3]+'</span><strong>'+r[0]+'</strong><small>'+r[5]+'</small></button>').join('')+'</div><p class="purposeNote" style="margin-top:16px">区域只是浏览入口，不代表内部生活相同。点进区域后可继续选择具体省区；内容以具体习惯和例子为主。</p></main>';return}
if(page==='friends'){let p=others().filter(friends);a.innerHTML='<main class="fresh"><header><div class="eyebrow">CONNECTIONS</div><h1>好友</h1><p>公开讨论留在首页；成为好友后，可以私聊或分享只给好友看的动态。</p></header><div class="friendSwitch"><button class="active">聊天与联系人</button><button onclick="circle()">朋友圈</button></div><div class="sectionHead"><h2>最近联系</h2>'+B('好友申请　'+inbox().length,"route('requests')")+'</div>'+(p.map(k=>'<div class="feedCard">'+B(av(k)+'<span><strong>'+P[k][0]+'</strong><br><small>'+tags(k)+'</small><br><small>你们已成为好友，打个招呼吧。</small></span>',"openchat('"+k+"')",'chatrow')+'</div>').join('')||'<div class="purposeNote">还没有好友。先在首页参与讨论，再从分享者主页发出好友申请。</div>')+'</main>';return}
if(page==='circle'){let m=moments();a.innerHTML='<main class="fresh"><div class="circleSticky"><div class="eyebrow">FRIENDS ONLY</div><div class="sectionHead"><div><h1>朋友圈</h1><small>好友之间的生活片段</small></div><button class="primaryAction" style="width:auto" onclick="route(\'momentNew\',1)">＋ 发动态</button></div><div class="friendSwitch"><button onclick="home(1)">好友聊天</button><button class="active">朋友圈</button></div></div>'+(m.slice(0,circleLimit).map(x=>'<article class="momentCard">'+author(x.p)+'<p>'+E(x.t)+'</p><div class="feedMeta"><span>仅好友可见</span><span>'+B((S.heart[S.me+':'+x.id]?'♥ 已赞':'♡ 点赞'),"heart('"+x.id+"')",'act')+'　'+B('评论 '+(S.reacs[x.id]||[]).length,"mc('"+x.id+"')",'act')+'</span></div></article>').join('')||'<div class="purposeNote">朋友圈还没有动态。点上方“发动态”，记录今天的一件小事。</div>')+(m.length>circleLimit?B('更多动态　↓','moreCircle()','soft full'):'')+'</main>';return}
if(['region','place','theme'].includes(page))a.innerHTML='<div class="fresh">'+a.innerHTML+'</div>'}
let old=paint;paint=function(){old();fresh()};try{document.getElementById('welcome')?.close();document.getElementById('welcome')?.remove();page='home';tab=0;paint()}catch(e){}
})();</script></html>
